dashboard.label: Demo Setup
dashboard.description: Install, load, and validate the ServiceNow ES demo app on any Splunk instance.

div.p: Portable synthetic ServiceNow, Mission Control source data, and SOC dashboards.

ol.li: Copy the demo_servicenow_es folder to $SPLUNK_HOME/etc/apps/ on your search head, or install the packaged .tar.gz from the repository dist/ directory.
Restart Splunk or reload the app from Manage Apps.

div.p: Create these indexes before loading demo data:
Use default/indexes.conf.example as a reference on Splunk Enterprise. On Splunk Cloud, create the indexes in the admin console.

div.div: Enable each scripted input once, wait for it to run, then disable it again to avoid duplicate events.

ol.li: Open Settings > Data inputs > Files & directories > Scripts.

Enable these inputs one at a time:
index_demo_csv.py servicenow_incidents.csv
index_demo_csv.py servicenow_changes.csv
index_demo_csv.py servicenow_cmdb.csv
index_demo_csv.py servicenow_users.csv
index_demo_csv.py servicenow_task_ci.csv
index_demo_csv.py es_incidents.csv
After each input runs successfully, disable it again.

div.p: To reload demo data later, delete marker files under local/loaded_*.marker in this app or run the script with --force from the CLI.
Open the Demo Searches menu and run:

ol.li: Copy the saved searches demo_es85_detection_soc1_template and demo_es85_detection_soc2_template into Security content > Event-based detections.
In each detection, set Output > Create findings with tokens such as $name$, $description$, and $risk_object$.
Enable the detections. You do not need a Mission Control Incidents adaptive response action in ES 8.5.

In Mission Control, save analyst queue views:
"soc_queue=\"SOC 1 Queue\"" "soc_queue=\"SOC 2 Queue\""

div.p: After data is loaded, open SOC Case Management from this app navigation menu.

div.h2: Refresh dates before a live demo
div.p: From the repository root on a machine with Python 3:
Reinstall or copy the refreshed app to your Splunk search head, then reload the scripted inputs with --force.
